title: State Compliance Bulletin: Estimated-Billing Share for Electricity by Community State
content:
# State Estimated-Billing Share — Utility Services Program Electricity

**Bulletin clause.** The state estimated-billing share on a Utility Services Program estimated electricity line is set by the community's state as recorded on the Apartment Home Lease:

- **0.95** when the state is CO or WA;
- **0.97** when the state is CA or AZ;
- the **whole rate** in any other state.

The usage charge of the estimated electricity line is taken at this share of the electricity rate.

## Reference by state

| State recorded on the lease | Share |
|---|---|
| CO | 0.95 |
| WA | 0.95 |
| CA | 0.97 |
| AZ | 0.97 |
| TX, GA or any other state | whole rate |

*Worked case (hypothetical):* 500.000 estimated kWh at a rate of $0.20 per kWh is $100.00 at the whole rate, $95.00 at 0.95 and $97.00 at 0.97.
